name: Whaling City Solar
old_description: Whaling City Solar is a residential and small-commercial solar installation company based in New Bedford, MA. We serve customers throughout the South Coast and Cape Cod. The company was founded in 2020 to create a better customer experience when purchasing solar equipment. We see many door-knocking, cold calling, and social media ad companies showing one picture of solar, while in reality, solar systems can take dozens of forms. We founded our company to tailor fit each and every array to its home and owners.
about:
Whaling City Solar was founded in 2020 in New Bedford, Massachusetts, to offer a better customer experience for residential and small-commercial solar purchases. The company was started by a team of engineers, project managers, and foremen who wanted to tailor each solar array to the specific home and owner, moving away from the high-pressure sales tactics common in the industry.

The firm handles the full installation process in-house, from initial site and financial assessment through permitting, installation, and commissioning. It manages all permitting paperwork—including Eversource interconnection agreements and town building and electrical permits—typically requiring two to five weeks for approvals. Installation crews usually complete a project in a single day, mounting rails and modules on the roof while simultaneously upgrading the electrical panel and inverters. The company works with equipment from brands such as REC, Solaria, and QCell modules; Enphase IQ8+ microinverters and SolarEdge string inverters; and Enphase Encharge, FranklinWH, and SPAN battery storage systems.

Whaling City Solar serves homeowners and small businesses across southeastern Massachusetts and Cape Cod, with recent projects completed in Mattapoisett, New Bedford, and Westport. Its service area covers the South Coast region, where the team lives and works, giving them familiarity with local weather, inspectors, and lenders.

The company differentiates itself by operating without sales commissions or call centers, providing direct access to technical staff. It promises a clear quote within 24 hours of a site visit, including costs, timelines, and projected financials, and emphasizes transparent, straightforward service rooted in the local community.
